question: Dhuska is the most popular food item of state of ______ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Dhuska** is a very popular food item in the state of** Jharkhand,** located in **eastern India.**
 
• It is a** deep-fried snack made from rice flour and chana dal (split Bengal gram)**, which is typically served with spicy potato curry or chutney.
 
• Jharkhand is a state located in eastern India, which was formed on** November 15, 2000,**
